features.title: Embeddable realm lifecycle facade
acceptance: Realm can create/start/health/save/stop/destroy twice in one process
No process exit or console-only control is required
C ABI ownership and error behavior are tested
features.notes: Versioned C ABI (schemas/abi/pocket_realm.h) backed by libpocketrealm.so, which wraps CMaNGOS/Playerbots for in-process control. The POCKET_EMBEDDED build routes the 18 process-exit() startup gates (DBC/map/table/schema) through POCKET_FATAL -> catchable fatal_error instead of killing the host. Master::Run(), the signal handlers, the console stdin loop, and realmd's main()/globals are gated out of the embedded build; the facade drives Master::StartDatabasesEmbedded/InitWorldEmbedded/StartNetworkEmbedded/StopEmbedded + a facade-owned realmd auth listener instead. Strategy A re-entrancy is proven: a full create/start/health/save/stop/destroy cycle runs twice in one process (the 4 DatabaseType globals are StopServer'd + World::m_stopEvent reset between cycles). Honest scope: realmd/characters/logs SQLite DBs seed cleanly from the MySQL dumps (0 errors, schema-version checks PASS); the world (mangos) DB is at an older schema snapshot than the core expects (z2815 vs z2830) so _StartDB reports a genuine DB error on it -- the former SQLite migration boundary, surfaced as FAILED not faked green. The 3 world-loop health conditions (WORLD_LOOP_RUNNING/LOCAL_ENDPOINTS_LISTENING/BOT_SUBSYSTEM_INITIALIZED) are blocked on the proprietary .dbc/.map client-derived data preparation (now O11) and would report BLOCKED_ON_CLIENT_DATA once the world machinery reaches them. A focused code review found and fixed 4 HIGH-severity defects (destructor thread-join -> std::terminate, no teardown on FAILED path, blocker_text lifetime, type-pun UB) plus 3 MEDIUM. Research alignment (1 August 2026): the canonical report selects native MariaDB and supervised component failure domains. This completed in-process/SQLite work remains valuable library-lane and control evidence, but it does not select the production topology or satisfy G0/G2.

features.title: G0 production packaging, process isolation, and capability record
acceptance: Checked-in AVD/capability records match adb for API, ABI lists, page size, graphics, RAM, and allocatable storage
PKG-01 and PKG-02 prove APK-owned native execution and isolated library-backed crash containment on the selected Android process model
PKG-06 passes startup and 30-minute native smoke checks on 4 KB and 16 KB lanes
An explicit ADR selects a current-target production topology and signed-code/mutable-data boundary; target-28 unpack/exec is not the production answer
features.notes: G0 packaging experiments completed on three AVD lanes via a reproducible serial+variant-specific host driver (tools/run_pkg_experiments.py). New native module native/packaging builds a PIE launcher (libpocket_pkg_launcher.so, renamed so AGP extracts it) and a JNI shim (libpocketpkgtest.so) that dlopens the real libpocketrealm.so by SONAME and exposes a deterministic abort(). Gradle stageNativeLibs stages the full closure (libpocketrealm.so + libpocketpkgtest.so + libpocket_pkg_launcher.so + libc++_shared.so; no platform libs) into the APK; production variants use useLegacyPackaging=false (.so stored uncompressed/page-aligned, loaded from the APK), and a pkgExperiment variant uses useLegacyPackaging=true (.so extracted to nativeLibraryDir with +x). PKG-01 runs on the experiment variant and sets LD_LIBRARY_PATH so the standalone launcher exec can resolve app libraries (the bare exec does not inherit the app linker namespace). PKG-02/06 run on the production (debug) variant in an isolated :pkg process bound cross-process via AIDL (IPkgIsolation). The driver targets exactly one --serial and one --variant per invocation (never connectedDebugAndroidTest, which would re-target the debug variant and run on all devices). Evidence is regenerated per-lane with timestamped logs + pulled capability reports. CapabilityReport uses a real EGL context for GL vendor/renderer/version and writes a pullable JSON the host merges into the AVD record; capture_avd.py compares six equivalent fields (sdkInt, pageSizeBytes, abilist, abilist32, abilist64, totalRamBytes) and records StorageManager vs df, app-GL vs host-GL, and host CPU/virtualization-backend/GPU-mode separately. The API 28 page size is derived reproducibly from /proc/self_maps (no getconf, no manual amendment). ADR-013 confirms Production Lane A (library-backed, supervised, fault-isolated) from evidence; it does not renumber ADR-001-012 / DECISIONS #1-45. O04 libpocketrealm.so facade retained as reusable library/control evidence. INTERNET permission added per schemas/flavor.json (loopback-only).
